item.title: Knife Terminal 1.1.0
item.description: Jobs: dictate a request on the phone or laptop and the executor Mac routes it to a project and runs it in its own git worktree — one commit pushed to main (or a branch + PR for risky changes), full diff in the notification. Knife Terminal menu → Run Jobs on This Mac picks the executor; other Macs are clients. Projects now carry their git remote and a one-line description for routing. New Project from Folder creates a repo + GitHub remote.
